value.bench_notes: One-piece investment-cast metal body. Fine botanical relief, gallery recesses, beadwork and proud setting stock require a sacrificial pattern. Stones shown are separate references, never cast metal. Drill/bur bearings and pavilion clearance to actual stones, preserve floor stock, set at the bench, polish rails and leaf edges while retaining the textured ground. Gate layout is preliminary.
